thread:
opsbot: :rotating_light: AUTOPAGE: Elevated 5xx error rate detected in eu-dedicated cluster affecting customer account Auriga (AU-RG-21). Error rate ~18% over last 3m. Autoscaling/fallback did not trigger due to config mismatch. Paged oncall-izzy.

oncall-izzy: Ack — I’m on it. Starting collection: `kubectl logs -n dedicated-eu -l pool=auriga --tail=200 | grep -E "5.."` and checking autoscaler events. Will report back in ~5.

sre-aaron: Seen similar before — likely KV client timeouts after last config push. If so, route affected customers to eu-burst pool and rollback deploy/2026-03-17-02:12. Tagging @eng-runtime-sam for runtime changes.

cs-joyce: CS here. Auriga is high-touch — need a short customer-facing impact statement and routing list (who to notify, cc). @acct-lead-maya can you confirm contacts?

acct-lead-maya: Confirming impacted accounts: Auriga (primary), Celadon Labs (secondary traffic), Meridian Finance (minor). Auriga primary ops: mara@auriga.com, eng-ops@auriga.com, csm-aaron@auriga.com. Use account routing flow: page CSM, then send tailored status with bridge info.

eng-runtime-sam: Mitigation started: rolling restart on eu-dedicated-auriga pool. Command run: `redwoodctl pool restart eu-dedicated-auriga --grace 30s --parallel 2`. Also tightened KV client retries temporarily. After first wave, 5xx dropped to ~6% in test subset.

pm-harpreet: Draft impact for Auriga (short): "We are investigating increased 5xx errors for inference requests in the EU dedicated cluster that may affect some requests for your service. Engineers have rerouted traffic and are performing rolling restarts; we expect progressive recovery. No customer data loss is expected. Next update in 30 minutes or upon resolution."

sre-aaron: Rolling back deploy tag `2026-03-17-02:12` now: `redwoodctl deploy rollback auriga-service 2026-03-17-02:12` — rollback complete. Metrics: error_rate -> 4% and trending down; p50 stable, p95 improved. Recommend status page update and customer notification.

opsbot: Proposed status page entry: "Investigating: Elevated 5xx errors in EU dedicated clusters affecting a subset of customers. Traffic has been rerouted from affected nodes and restarts are in progress. We will provide updates every 30 minutes or on resolution."

cs-joyce: Customer notify draft (Auriga):
Subject: "Redwood: Service degradation affecting inference (EU) — Auriga"
Body (short): "Hi Mara — we’re investigating increased 5xx errors impacting some inference requests for your account in our EU dedicated cluster. Engineers have rerouted traffic and performed node restarts; service is recovering. Next update in 30 minutes. For urgent issues call +1-800-111-222 ext 9 or reply to this thread. — Joyce, CSM"

acct-lead-maya: :thumbsup: Approved. Send immediately to primary contacts and cc legal for records. Also set up 1:1 bridge with Auriga ops on Webex (link in DM).

oncall-izzy: Sending notification to Auriga now. Handoff note: pairing with night oncall @sre-lina in 15m. Current metrics before handoff: error_rate 2.1%, p95 latency 430ms. Alerts left at high sensitivity; escalation rung set for any spike >5%.

pm-harpreet: Action items captured: postmortem owner @sre-aaron, customer outreach owner @cs-joyce, infra deploy rollback doc update by @eng-runtime-sam. Will schedule blameless review next week.

sre-lina: Acknowledged handoff. I’ll watch the alerts and keep the bridge open for first hour. If errors rebound, re-open paging with tag #auriga and escalate to SEs.

opsbot: Status update posted: "Partial degradation mitigated; traffic rerouted and nodes restarted. Monitoring for recurrence." Please react with :white_check_mark: when you’ve sent customer messages or completed handoff.

cs-joyce: Sent initial customer note and created ticket RED-INC-2026-431. Added Auriga contacts and set follow-ups for 30m.

acct-lead-maya: Confirmed Auriga on bridge, ops engaged. Good job everyone.

sre-aaron: Closing active mitigation — keeping incident open for postmortem & rollback doc. Will start RCA collection.

opsbot: Incident state: monitoring (post-mitigation). Next update scheduled in 30m or on any change. :white_check_mark:
